title: 吉路尔chaser pro外胎1300km使用体验
notes: Owner post (2026-02-09): Chaser Pro 28C after 1,300 km, bought second-hand for CNY 107: good dry grip, stable in corners and no skid when braking on a 17% descent; the owner avoided hard braking and leaning in the wet and gives no wet verdict. Clear road feel at 100 psi without harshness; one puncture from a 4-5 cm nail over sand, gravel and potholes; soft and easy to fit by hand; 216 g at 28C.
